headline: Fengyun satellite extreme-weather AI model announced at official conference; media report names two systems
summary: The Hunan Provincial Government reports that a Fengyun satellite extreme-weather AI model was formally released at the National Satellite Meteorological Center-hosted user conference on 29 October 2026. A Chinese-language Science and Technology Daily article hosted by Beijing’s NCSTI names two systems: a typhoon image-interpretation model and a short-range severe-convection warning model. It reports their intended functions and timing specifications, but no forecast-skill evaluation or deployment evidence was inspected. The government event report confirms a model release; the two variant identities and performance figures remain attributed reporting.
